categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and adds unit test coverage in src/test/pmt_tests.cpp and src/test/pow_tests.cpp for consensus-adjacent code paths.
categories.rationale: Adds unit test coverage for previously untested edge cases in partial merkle tree extraction and proof-of-work target calculations. It covers malformed merkle trees at the 16,666 transaction limit boundary and verifies GetBitsProof behavior for zero, negative, and overflowing nBits representations, with review confirming it kills mutants in these paths.
